items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses a CD mentioning Philly Joe Jones and reacts to a statement on it ('The guy made a mistake'), but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Joe Jones in this context.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, man. I was very impressed with Elvin, man. Elvin did things man, nobody else could do. He’d played (unintelligible) rhythms as they call them, whatever, he crossed rhythms man. I remember hearing him one time man; they’re playing a ballad, right. All of a sudden man, old thunder (unintelligible), man he played some that was just -- you talking about out of left field, I mean -- and came back in. Goddamn, it worked. But to hear, I mean all of sudden, you know. Elvin was something else man. Well I was…
There was a CD that you had yesterday where it starts out talking about how Philly Joe Jones, that you were -­
